items.q: I would stand on the floor and look at all these peoples, you know, the Cuba Austin's and what have you.

ctx.x: Omaha, Nebraska. We all called him Tubby. My eyes was getting opened then. I would stand on the floor and look at all these peoples, you know, the Cuba Austin's and what have you.
...What can you say about Cuba and who was he with?
